name: Customs recorder
design: Medium sturdy elderly male with light grey mottled hide, pronounced brow folds, blunt tusks and white-black dreadlocks tucked into collar. Long charcoal coat with bronze horizontal chest toggles, slim beige diagonal sash, knee-length side panels, low open boots revealing claws. Holds an open small hinged record tablet with no visible lettering in one hand, stylus tucked behind belt. Thoughtful poised idle stance.
